repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate computed the difference as ($v2 - $v1), whereas the IR specifies ($v1 - $v1). Given the input history where volume started at 0 and rose to 20, the IR condition (0 - 20 >= 20) is false, so no action occurs. The candidate condition (20 - 0 >= 20) is true, causing the extra action observed in F2.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the subtraction order in the conditional guard from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR specification. This ensures the action triggers only when the volume has dropped by at least 20 units, not when it has risen.
